proposedDesign.name: Cross-Town Railway
proposedDesign.serviceConcept: A staged Cobalt/Amber exploration subway, then Data/Gateway/Empty Eight and mountain extensions, with a separately converted B09 scenic shuttle. No sealed future stub, back-of-house/restricted space, or maintenance route is presented as passenger access.
proposedDesign.alignmentRule: No exact alignment is selected by this reconciliation. The first design freeze must choose a source-proven route from current terrain and exact ownership, not draw a line through catalog envelopes.
proposedDesign.stationRule: Use accepted public anchors only after landing, accessibility, enclosure, and ownership surveys. Restricted MP01/MP05 areas are not public stations.
proposedDesign.deliveryPattern: Survey and access first; civil guideway and the mandatory 6x6 behind-wall service corridor next; active vehicles and public service last. Each bounded package must be independently useful, guarded, journaled, reversible, and post-verified.

hardExecutionBoundaries: This plan contains no block operations and authorizes no world, database, service, or publication mutation.
A catalog status or planning envelope is never a source guard, target set, route pass, or overwrite right.
Use a fresh immutable same-invocation source for every physical release; historical accepted snapshots remain provenance only after later commits.

Require complete canonical block states, exact forward/inverse operations, strict-noop parser checks, exact source preflight, live entity clearance, block-entity/container/protected exclusion or exact reviewed migration, journaled execution, fresh post snapshot, post QA, and rollback preflight.
Unknown fluid, gravity, entity, container, mechanism, utility, drainage, or protected state fails only the affected package and dependent interface; it does not become a global plan hold.
Do not open Empty Eight future stubs, C2, C3, P1-B12, secure Cheyenne, FIRE-EG-B, or any exterior/utility/drainage interface without a separate exact release.
Do not claim whole-route, passenger, public, rescue, accessibility, hydraulic, utility, or operational commissioning from a bounded surface, passive rail, or maintenance-shuttle package.
Database import, map generation, media capture, and external publication follow accepted physical QA and never manufacture acceptance.
